posts.name: mackcrockett
posts.cooked:
A WWII Haka I'd imagine in the Pacific theatre, mainly because of his Maori background and to underscore how big that war was, not everyone fought the nazis. 

I could see a WWII version of Expat, not as her, but as a rogue commando with a penchant for overwhelming firepower.  none of her weapons wouldn't work for that  era.

Scholar might have been around during that period, but I'm not sure he'd have gotten involved. As levels of crises go, geopolitics is a little different than true world being invaded by aliens stuff.

Changing some lore around, Ra is technically immortal, but the staff was entombed at the time. someone could ahve unearthed the tomb during the North African campaign (probably a Brit) and reinterred the staff after the war out of fear that it would fall into the wrong hands. 

Both Fixer and Nightmist promos could be done for their mentors or mentors mentors, Fixer learned from someone, and someone was keeping Gloomweaver in check all those years. Again, not sure either of their predecessors would have been involved, Fixer could have learned from martial artists from a wide background and, barring some Indiana Jones level storyline, the mystic protectors of earth probably weren't concerned as much with the fate of Europe (now, throw in an ark of the covenant and we're cooking.) 

Just some thoughts.
